title: Earnings Call Risk Map Input Fixture
description: Machine-readable reference for the zero-dependency input fixture shape accepted by earnings-call-risk-map. Runtime validation remains intentionally lightweight; this file documents supported fields for authors and integrators.

schema_version.description: Fixture schema version. Use 0.1 for the current input shape.

company.description: Company display name used in reports.

as_of.description: Review date used for stale/static-data comparisons.

data_cutoff.description: Latest source-data date represented by the fixture.

catalysts.description: Dated future events or review triggers.

source_attribution.description: Public-source attribution records for the fixture.

source_type.description: Provenance class such as company_investor_relations, sec_filing, transcript, or user_synthesis.

accessed_at.description: Date the static fixture author recorded the source URL.

static_notice.description: Short label clarifying that the fixture is static and not live data.

date.description: Source date. Falls back to data_cutoff if omitted.

topic.description: Topic label used in report sections.

type.description: Note provenance, such as management_claim, analyst_question, user_synthesis, transcript_excerpt, or note.

text.description: Text scored for risk and opportunity keywords.

evidence_url.description: Public source URL. Missing URLs enter the review queue.

source_attribution.description: Public-source attribution rendered with the item.

value.description: KPI value as shown in source material.

direction.description: up, better, or positive adds opportunity weight; down, worse, or negative adds risk weight.

date.description: KPI observation date. Falls back to data_cutoff if omitted.

observation.description: Text scored alongside the KPI name and direction.

source_attribution.description: Public-source attribution rendered with the KPI.

date.description: Catalyst date used for timeline sorting.

description.description: Context for the event or review trigger.

source_attribution.description: Public-source attribution rendered with the catalyst.

source_attribution.static_notice: Static educational fixture; not live data.

notes.text: Management described continued growth in enterprise pipeline, but noted demand pressure in one international region.

kpis.name: Net retention
kpis.observation: Improved versus prior quarter with growth in larger accounts.

catalysts.title: Investor day
catalysts.description: Management expected to update long-term margin framework.
